title: Rate vs Volume Mix Decomposition
description: Separating performance changes into pure rate improvements versus compositional volume mix shifts.
conditions: Aggregate average rate changed (e.g. Average Order Value increased, or Click-Through Rate dropped)
Underlying population mix across sub-tiers or segments shifted over the same time horizon
recommended_methods: Mix-Rate-Volume variance decomposition: Delta = Volume Effect + Rate Effect + Mix Interaction Effect
Standardized weighting holding baseline segment proportions constant
selection_rules: If an average rate changed while subgroup rates remained flat, diagnose Simpson's paradox via Mix Shift
limitations: Requires granular sub-segment records across both comparison periods
Interaction term (Delta_Rate * Delta_Mix) must be transparently allocated
